mcqs.stem: A widow wants to transfer an asset expected to appreciate greatly to her son. From an income tax perspective, when is a gift during life least favorable compared with a bequest at death?

choices.text: When the asset has a low basis and the son may sell it soon after her death
choices.explanation: Correct. Gifted property keeps the donor's low basis; inherited property gets a stepped-up basis (§1014).

choices.text: When the asset has a basis above FMV
choices.explanation: A bequest would step the basis down, too.

mcqs.explanation: Gifted property keeps the donor's low basis; inherited property gets a stepped-up basis (§1014).

tbs.title: Estimated tax and a consolidated group — Pine Holdings
tbs.instructions: Pine Holdings, Inc. is a calendar-year corporation. Answer the questions about its 2025 estimated tax and its consolidated return.

exhibits.title: Estimated tax
exhibits.content:
- Pine had taxable income of $1,900,000 in 2024 and **$400,000** of 2024 tax.
- Pine expects **$600,000** of 2025 tax (consolidated).

exhibits.title: Group structure and 2025 results
exhibits.content:
| Corporation | Ownership | Separate taxable income |
|---|---|---:|
| Pine (parent) | — | 800,000 |
| Sub One | 100% by Pine | (200,000) |
| Sub Two | 85% by Pine | 150,000 |
| Sub Three | 70% by Pine | 90,000 |

- Pine's $800,000 includes a **$50,000** gain on land sold to Sub One in 2025. Sub One still holds the land.
- Sub Two paid Pine a $40,000 dividend, which is excluded from Pine's $800,000.

parts.prompt: Estimated tax installments (minimum to avoid a penalty).

rows.label: April 15 installment
rows.explanation: Large corporation may use prior-year tax for the first installment only: 25% × 400,000 = **100,000**.

rows.label: Consolidated taxable income
rows.explanation: 800,000 − 50,000 deferred intercompany gain − 200,000 + 150,000 = **700,000** (Sub Three isn't a member; the dividend is eliminated).

rows.label: Is Sub Three included in the consolidated return?
rows.explanation: Membership requires 80% of vote and value.

rows.label: When does Pine take the $50,000 land gain into account?
options: When Sub One sells the land outside the group
rows.answer: When Sub One sells the land outside the group

rows.label: Form each subsidiary files to consent to the first consolidated return
rows.explanation: Form 851 is the affiliations schedule filed by the parent.
